images.name: light
images.prompt:
Create a NEW office level panorama with exact spatial composition of reference 1 Kyoto veranda and reference 2 lab hall. Ultra-wide 3:1, 2000x667, softly faceted painterly 3D game art. This must NOT be an ordinary rectilinear office photograph or a close-up desk scene.
Camera seated eye level, horizon 48% up from bottom, curved cylindrical 270-degree wide-angle panorama. Ceiling crossbeams, suspended fluorescent strips, cable trays and floorboard/carpet tile seams sweep gently around viewer and converge toward dead-centre focus, like Kyoto roof and floor, no fisheye bulge top/bottom.
Office translation: viewer on a raised office mezzanine / reception deck overlooking a vast deep retro 1990s administrative hall. Two substantial ivory columns with muted teal bases frame big centre opening at same positions as Kyoto posts. Low wood-and-metal rails at deck edge left/right, broad central gap. Covered office wings run away along both sides like Kyoto shoji corridors; tall windows, filing cabinets, bookcases, printers, plants, trays, carts, desks and tucked chairs richly populate outer edges and midground. Main hall has rows of workstations to both sides, central lane clear. About ten metres away a small perfectly centred warmly lit mailroom doorway with pigeonhole shelves inside forms calm distant focus; softened lower contrast far wall.
Keep broad near foreground deck floor open and visible. Retain user's requested EMPTY wooden monitor desk but set it into the scene ahead of player, several feet away toward deck edge, SMALL and LOW in frame, not a giant near-camera tabletop: width roughly 30 percent of panorama, top at 70-77 percent down frame, full front and legs visible with clear foreground floor beneath it. Desk centre entirely bare for a separate in-game 3D CRT monitor and items, only a few paper sheets at far corners. NO monitor, tower, keyboard, mug or stapler on that desk. Desk must not obscure distant mailroom or dominate floor. Natural horizontal tabletop consistent with seated camera, straight local edges with panoramic environment curvature.
Materials honey wood, cream cabinets, white columns, blue-gray carpet tiles, muted teal accents. LIGHT state bright cool fluorescent overhead lights, soft peach-lavender afternoon through side windows, small warm desk lamps. No people, readable text, labels, UI, weapons, vignette. One full-bleed panorama.

images.name: dark
images.prompt: Make DARK night edit of this exact office panorama. Preserve every object position, framing, perspective, ceiling beams, columns, desk with papers, rails, floor seams, side workstations, distant mailroom doorway. Change only illumination: overhead fluorescent fixtures off, windows deep violet-blue night, office in cool indigo teal shadows with warm amber wall sconces and existing desk lamps. Distant mailroom remains warm inviting focal point. Soft indirect light keeps the small empty player desk and side furnishings readable. No monitor or other items added to player desk; centre tabletop bare, papers stay at edges. No green monitor glow. Same painterly 3D art and 3:1 panorama 2000x667. No people, text, UI or vignette.
